$comment: Single source of truth for the intake fields. Per field, lis is the LIS value it is compared with by the fusion engine (record.column; patient.name and physician.name are first name and both surnames) and the compare mode for that comparison, or null when the LIS does not hold it; default is the system default, the third and lowest-priority source; printed, on a normalised field, lists the words it may be printed with, so that its value can be found on the page (month names of a date, the words for each value of an enum); label is the English name shown to people, label_es the Spanish one. stored_as, when present, is the form the system of record keeps a value read from the document in, which the fusion engine proposes: digits keeps only the number (an age read as 22 años is proposed as 22); the reading itself stays exact. Read by the Python generator/evaluator and by the Next.js app. Do not duplicate this configuration in prompts, backend or UI.

compare_modes.digits: Equality of the digit sequences only (separators and spaces ignored).
compare_modes.alnum_upper: Equality of the alphanumeric characters only, upper-cased.
compare_modes.phone: Equality of the digit sequences after dropping a Spanish country prefix (+34 or 0034).
compare_modes.person_name: Equality of the words of a name in any order, compared like casefold, commas ignored: 'GARCÍA LÓPEZ, MARÍA' is 'María García López'.

fields.name: Paciente
fields.label: Patient name
fields.description: Full name of the patient exactly as printed.

fields.name: FechaNacimiento
fields.label: Date of birth
fields.description: Date of birth normalized to dd/mm/yyyy regardless of how it is printed.

fields.name: Edad
fields.label: Age
fields.description: Age exactly as printed (may include a unit such as 'años').

fields.name: Sexo
fields.label: Sex
fields.description: H = hombre, M = mujer, U = unknown/other. Normalized from any printed representation.

fields.name: DocumentoIdentidad
fields.label: Identity document
fields.description: DNI, NIE or passport number exactly as printed.

fields.name: Telefono
fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Patient contact phone exactly as printed.

fields.name: NombreMedico
fields.label: Requesting physician
fields.description: Name and surnames of the requesting physician as printed, without any title or honorific.

fields.name: NumeroColegiado
fields.label: Physician registration number
fields.description: Medical college registration number exactly as printed.

fields.name: NumeroPeticion
fields.label: Request number
fields.description: Request identifier. May be printed more than once (header, barcode label); returned once.

fields.name: NombreMutua
fields.label: Insurer name
fields.description: Insurance company / mutual name exactly as printed: the company that pays for the request, often printed as the letterhead of its own request form. Never the hospital, clinic or laboratory where the patient is seen or the tests are done. Null when no insurer is printed.

fields.name: NumeroSolicitudMutua
fields.label: Insurer request number
fields.label_es: Número de solicitud de la mutua
fields.description: Insurer-side request/solicitud number exactly as printed.

fields.name: NumeroAutorizacion
fields.label: Authorization number
fields.description: Insurer authorization number exactly as printed.

fields.name: NumeroTarjeta
fields.label: Insurance card number
fields.description: Insurance card number exactly as printed.

tests.name: tests
tests.label: Requested tests
tests.description: Each requested test is one independent entry. Visual grouping (boxes, tables, profile headings) must never be used to merge entries. Group headings are not tests.
